Class LabMonitor

java.lang.Object
concurrent.LabMonitor
public class LabMonitor extends Object
The lab monitor class is the monitor for the management of the resources (Equipment) requested by threads(RequestTaks). It ensures the resources get taken only when they are available (they aren't being used by anyone), if a request for a non available equipment is's put in queue waiting for the resource to be available. It also implements a cap on the number of equipment that can be "stored" in the lab. It communicates to the outside by notifying LabListeners. It implements save and load features for it's state.
Author:
Marini Enrico

  • Constructor Details

    • LabMonitor

      public LabMonitor()
      Constructor method for the LabMonitor class It initializes the equipment list as an empty arraylist of equipment. It initializes the user list as an empty arraylist of users. It initializes the request list as an empty arraylist of requests. It starts in a paused state. It sets the starting maxEquip value to the default value

    • createSnapshot

      public LabSnapshot createSnapshot()
      Method to create a LabSnapshot of the lab. The lab get's paused before saving to prevent changes from happening during writing. The ACTIVE requests are snapshot as CANCELLED and all of the equipment they obtained gets released
      Returns:
      the LabSnapshot representing the lab state
